model: EWWD / EWWH I-, J- and K-series water-cooled chillers (Daikin Applied Europe)
applies_to: Daikin Applied Europe EWWD and EWWH I-, J- and K-series water-cooled chillers with a MicroTech 4 controller running the EWWD software.
summary: The EWWD/EWWH I/J/K chillers use a MicroTech 4 controller with the EWWD software. BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP comes from a POL908/POL904 module or the onboard software option. The list covers unit enable, mode, network setpoints and capacity limit, water temperatures, up to three refrigerant circuits, compressor off/auto commands, pump status, energy data and a long set of individual alarm BVs plus alarm index/code AVs.
notes: Shares the core unit objects (BV 2, MV 3, AV 3-7, BI 3/10, AV 900-905) with the other Daikin Applied Europe MicroTech 4 chiller guides.
MV 1 is printed for both UnitStatus and CondWFlowState; the object without a confirmed instance is listed without one.
Circuit 3 objects only apply to three-circuit units.
Daikin France (Easyspec) publishes this guide as a PDF inside a zip together with the Modbus guide.

integration.summary: Select network control at the unit (CtrlSource BI 3 then reads Network), enable the chiller with UnitEnableStp, and write the mode, cool setpoint and capacity limit. Monitor unit status, leaving water temperature, AlarmOutput and the fault index/code.

minimum_points.name: UnitModeSetpointNetwork
minimum_points.why: Ice / cool / heat / pursuit mode command

minimum_points.name: NetworkCoolTempSetpoint
minimum_points.why: Leaving water cool setpoint from the BMS

minimum_points.name: CtrlSource
minimum_points.why: Shows whether network control is active

integration.enable: CtrlSource (BI 3) reads 0 = Network / 1 = Local and is read-only over BACnet, so network control has to be selected at the unit; the guide does not describe that step. With network control active the BMS writes UnitEnableStp (BV 2) = Enable, then the mode (MV 3) and network setpoints.
setup: BACnet IP comes from the POL908 module or, on MicroTech 4, the onboard BACnet IP software option; BACnet MS/TP comes from the POL904 module or the onboard BACnet MS/TP software option.
BACnet IP module defaults: device instance 1, UDP port 47808, DHCP off; set Apply Changes = Yes after editing, which restarts the controller.

BACnet MS/TP module defaults: MAC address 24, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 1; the device instance is derived from the production number and date code. Cycle power after changing the address.
Settings are under Main menu > Commissioning > BACnet IP Setup / BACnet MSTP Setup on the unit display (service password).
gotchas: Compressor start counters and run-hour AVs are marked writable; don't write them from the BMS.
Alarms come as Warning, Problem and Fault index/code AVs (900-905); the code table is in the guide.
MV 4 Units selects metric or English units for the BACnet values; set it once, not cyclically.
The per-circuit compressor Off/Auto commands (MV 430, 440, 1762) can take compressors out of service; leave them on Auto.
